scene: Yanking the antenna opens three transport gates across the breezy rooftop.
picture: Flat side view along the rooftop ground line. On the far left, an open metal freight lift cage hums. Left of centre, the boy in the denim jacket holds a cut antenna wire. At centre waits a glowing night tram on a rooftop track. On the far right, a wooden rowing boat rests atop a water-filled chute.
shown: an open metal freight lift cage with glowing indicator on the far left
a sleek night tram docked at a suspended rooftop rail at centre
a wooden rowing boat resting on a sloped water flume on the far right
